title: Austin Tackles Environment, Health, & Growth
summary:
*   **Barton Springs Zone Legal Issues:** Discussed ongoing litigation related to development regulations in the environmentally sensitive Barton Springs Zone, including legal fees.
*   **Community Health & Planning:** Received updates on the local HIV/AIDS situation and a presentation on the Chestnut Neighborhood Plan.
*   **Green Energy & Climate Action:** Approved grants for climate protection programs and energy-efficient appliance rebates for a large apartment complex.
*   **Airport Development:** Authorized a contract for demolition and remediation work at the Austin-Bergstrom International Airport.
